hotel_bridal_room.text: Inside the dressing room stands another door. A brass panel glows BRIDAL PRIVACY SYSTEM — AUTHORIZED USER: BRIDE. There is no ordinary handle. A white wedding gown hangs nearby. The organizer is already gone.
hotel_bridal_room.notes: Owner approved four dressing-room actions; inspection must reveal safety and identification clues before the risky gown action appears.

text.desc: You knock. A green light blinks.

text.say: Knocking is not a recognized access credential.

text.desc: There is no handle or keyhole. A polished brass panel holds a camera and a small screen: BRIDAL PRIVACY SYSTEM. OCCUPANT AUTHORIZATION: BRIDE ONLY. VISUAL IDENTIFICATION: ENABLED. PRE-WEDDING GROOM EXCLUSION: ENABLED.

text.say: Please maintain a respectful distance from the bride.
That is not sufficient proof of being the bride.
The bridal lavatory is provided exclusively for the bride's comfort.

choices.text: ASK WHAT QUALIFIES SOMEONE AS THE BRIDE.
STEP BACK AND INSPECT THE WEDDING GOWN.
GIVE UP ON THIS DOOR AND LEAVE.

hotel_bridal_door_focus.notes: Focus A close-up. Show missing ring choice visibly locked with REQUIRES: WEDDING RING — LOT 31, NOT IN INVENTORY in future UI. Repeat emergency attempts should remain greyed ALREADY DENIED (current engine may hide).

hotel_bridal_criteria.speaker: bridal_door_ai

text.say: HOW DOES THIS THING KNOW WHO THE BRIDE IS?
Bridal identification is based on visual recognition, ceremonial attire, and an approved bridal profile.
WHAT IF THE BRIDE CHANGES HER CLOTHES?
WHAT IF SOMEONE ELSE WEARS HER DRESS?
The Bridal Privacy System is designed to recognize the bride.
Correct. Your question concerns someone who is not the bride.

text.desc: You glance at the wedding gown hanging across the room.

text.say: Appropriate bridal presentation is an important consideration.
AND IF I LOOK LIKE A BRIDE?
You may submit yourself for identification.

text.desc: The camera swivels toward you.

text.say: You are not presently a bride.

choices.text: TELL THE DOOR YOU ARE THE BRIDE.

hotel_bridal_criteria.notes: Only explains why the gown might matter; the gown safety clue comes from its own INSPECT interaction.

hotel_bridal_false_claim.speaker: bridal_door_ai

text.desc: You straighten your clothes and face the camera.
The camera examines your face, clothing, and shoes.

text.say: You are not dressed for the occasion.
Weddings often are. That does not make you the bride.

text.desc: The indicator turns red.
You stare at the panel.

choices.text: RETURN TO THE SMART DOOR OPTIONS.

hotel_bridal_false_claim.notes: Claim becomes ALREADY ATTEMPTED in future choice UI, with no fatality or fee.

hotel_bridal_emergency_override.speaker: bridal_door_ai

text.desc: You press EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE.

text.say: Please state the nature of your emergency.
I NEED TO USE THE TOILET. URGENTLY.

text.desc: The panel displays PROCESSING.

text.say: Emergency overrides require confirmation from an authorized user.
IF I WERE AN AUTHORIZED USER, I WOULDN'T NEED AN OVERRIDE!
Correct. We receive very few applications.

text.desc: The screen returns to BRIDAL PRIVACY PROTECTED.

choices.text: RETURN TO THE SMART DOOR OPTIONS.

hotel_bridal_emergency_override.notes: One shared rejection; future UI greys the attempted choice as REQUEST ALREADY DENIED. No new fee.

hotel_bridal_ring_argument.speaker: bridal_door_ai

text.desc: You hold the silver wedding ring beneath the camera.

text.say: THIS IS THE WEDDING RING. DOES THAT COUNT?
It establishes possession of wedding property. It does not establish bridal identity.
IF I HAD IT AT THE WEDDING, WOULD THAT HELP?
Possibly with the ceremony. Not with this door.
YOU HAVE A CAMERA. YOU CAN SEE I NEED THE TOILET.
Visual distress is not a valid entry credential.

text.desc: The indicator remains red. You put the ring away, thoroughly fed up.

choices.text: RETURN TO THE SERVICE CORRIDOR AND TRY THE STAFF LAVATORY.
GIVE UP AND HEAD OUTSIDE TOWARD THE PARK.

hotel_bridal_ring_argument.notes: Approved ring rejection never opens door and does not consume ring; argument pushes player back to another bathroom or the park exit.

text.desc: An elaborate white wedding gown hangs from a wheeled dressing stand. The waist is alarmingly narrow. Something metallic glints beneath the bodice.
You pull aside the lace. A motor draws thin cables through the bodice and neckline. The label reads AUTOFIT BRIDAL SYSTEM — ONE SIZE FITS EVERYONE EVENTUALLY.
SAFETY NOTICE: Disconnect automatic fitting mechanism before removing or adjusting garment.
Apparently even wedding dresses are automated now.

text.say: That garment is reserved for the bride.

choices.text: HOLD THE GOWN UP TO THE CAMERA.

hotel_bridal_gown_focus.notes: Owner-approved Focus A reveals danger; risky TRY appears only after gown INSPECT. AutoFit has a manual slack tab to discover separately. No fatality during inspection.

text.desc: You lift the lining and follow cables to a motor beneath the waist. The cables run through the bodice and around the neckline.
Beside the motor is a brass tab: MANUAL SLACK. Below it, in smaller letters: NOT AN EMERGENCY STOP.
You press the tab. The neckline loosens slightly. You release it; the cables stay slack. At least you know where the release is.

text.say: Unauthorized garment adjustments may invalidate the bridal presentation warranty.
IS THIS THING STILL TURNED ON?
The garment is ready for fitting.

text.desc: You carefully replace the lining.

choices.text: HOLD THE GOWN UP TO THE CAMERA.

hotel_bridal_gown_motor.notes: Finding manual slack provides one nonstacking +1 survival modifier for risky dressing d6.

hotel_bridal_gown_camera.speaker: bridal_door_ai

text.desc: You hold the gown up to the camera as though it might count as a person.

text.say: No bride detected inside bridal attire.

text.desc: You return the gown to the stand.

hotel_bridal_gown_camera.notes: Owner-approved nonfatal rejection; holding the gown is not enough to open the door.

text.desc: You look at the dress. You look at the locked bathroom. There are moments when dignity must take a back seat.
You step into the gown and pull it over your shoulders. A motor hums beneath the fabric.
The waist tightens. Then the shoulders. Then the neckline.
The motor accelerates.

hotel_bridal_gown_try.notes: Hidden d6 base 1–4 fatal, 5–6 survive; +1 if manually examined release: raw 1–3 fatal, 4–6 survive. Roll after a deliberate TRY ON action only.

text.desc: The neckline draws tighter. You search beneath the fabric for the release.
The motor interprets your struggling as a poor fit. It makes another adjustment.
The mirror reflects a beautifully tailored wedding dress. The fitting system gives a cheerful chime.
Unfortunately, there is no longer anyone available to wear it.

deathPopup.title: MADE TO MEASURE
deathPopup.description: The AutoFit system guarantees a perfect silhouette. Breathing room is available at additional cost.

fatal_bridal_made_to_measure.notes: Owner-approved fourth Chapter 4 fatal ending; art deferred. A white gown hanging on its stand, absurdly cinched bodice, one abandoned shoe beneath. No face, body details, gore, or complex machinery. One popup title and one narrative, no unrelated title.

text.desc: The neckline tightens.
Your fingers find the little brass tab beneath the waist. You press it. The neckline loosens just enough for you to breathe.
You wrench at the fabric, fighting for breath. A seam gives way with a sharp click, and the pressure eases.
The motor stops.
You stand before the mirror, sweating inside an extraordinarily expensive wedding dress.
You approach the bathroom. The camera examines you.
A green light illuminates.
An electronic chime sounds.
The lock clicks open.
For the first time since entering the hotel, a bathroom door actually opens for you.

hotel_bridal_autofit_survived.notes: No ring consumed, no second roll. Worn gown is a temporary costume, not an inventory item. The bridal registration fee persists on exit.

hotel_bridal_door_options.text: The smart door remains locked. The camera follows you while the approved bridal-access options wait on its brass panel.

choices.text: ASK WHAT QUALIFIES SOMEONE AS THE BRIDE.
STEP BACK AND INSPECT THE WEDDING GOWN.
GIVE UP ON THIS DOOR AND LEAVE.

hotel_bridal_door_options.notes: Return hub avoids repeating the entire door inspection or previously exhausted dialogue. Future UI should show exhausted and missing-item actions as disabled, with subtitles, not silently hide them.
